> However, I got the Lasombra starter deck today, and she was the first
> card on top.
>

Well, she's not promo-only. She and Sasha Vykos are promo cards
that also happen to be available in their respective starters.

> Dan Murdock, Mariana Gilbert...still the only 2 cards that aren't
> available from the card sets.

Dan Murdock and Mariana Gilbert are promo-only cards, yes.
